slides.body:
via Micah Blumberg, micah@vrma.io

Sometimes I get requests to share news of an upcoming event, a story, a company or a project that people want others to know about. I am usually happy to do it when I have time, especially if its related to VR, AR, AI, Neuroscience, BCI, CompNeuro. Blockchain, Mathematics, or Leading ideas in Science & Technology. Here are a few events that people let me know about. If you are in Redmond, London or Hyderbad on these dates you can check them out.

One event in London (UK) next week, 22–23 Jan
